<script>
(function() {
  var total = 26;
  var current = 1;
  function show(n) {
    for (var i = 1; i <= total; i++) {
      var id = "slide-" + (i < 10 ? "0" + i : i);
      document.getElementById(id).style.display = (i === n) ? "block" : "none";
    }
    document.getElementById("slide-counter").textContent = n + " / " + total;
  }
  document.getElementById("slide-prev").addEventListener("click", function() {
    current = current > 1 ? current - 1 : total;
    show(current);
  });
  document.getElementById("slide-next").addEventListener("click", function() {
    current = current < total ? current + 1 : 1;
    show(current);
  });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") { current = current > 1 ? current - 1 : total; show(current); }
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") { current = current < total ? current + 1 : 1; show(current); }
  });
})();
</script>
